mechanism_narrative: The unemployment rate (UNRATE) is negatively correlated with S&P 500 returns, so higher UNRATE levels predict negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is observed, or the Rank IC of UNRATE is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 3.0% signals a monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or the Rank IC of FEDFUNDS > 3.0% is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and decreases in INDPRO (industrial production) signal a stagflationary environment, which increases risk aversion and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises and INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC of the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (indicated by strong GDP growth, GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals an overheating economy, which triggers a Fed tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 2.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC of the condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 2000.0 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 2000.0, or the Rank IC of HOUST < 2000.0 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 115.0 signals a slowdown in the manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate earnings growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 115.0, or the Rank IC of INDPRO < 115.0 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) above 195.0 signals persistent inflation, which leads to a Fed tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 195.0, or the Rank IC of CPIAUCSL > 195.0 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above 350,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 350000, or the Rank IC of RSAFS > 350000 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
